name: make-progressive-doodle-illustrations
title_zh: 三帧累加不重画，白纸黑豆讲清一个知识点
tagline_zh: 把一段文字拆成三幕，每幕在原图上只添新墨不擦旧笔。适合教程、科普、产品说明——读者盯着同一张画，知识一层层长出来。
tagline_en: Splits your copy into 3 scenes, each frame adds ink without erasing the last. Perfect for tutorials and.
desc_en: Turn one user-provided copy block into original white-paper black-bean doodle illustration sets at the requested or context-appropriate aspect ratio with built-in $imagegen: automatically split the copy into scenes and generate exactly three cumulative full-canvas PNG states per scene, where each later image adds one knowledge module without moving or repainting earlier ink. Use for 白底手绘、小黑插画、三帧累加
why_zh: 它不重新构图，只做加法。后一帧永远保留前一帧的全部笔迹，视觉上形成「同一张纸越画越满」的累积感。
why_en: It never re-composes—only adds. Each frame keeps every prior stroke, so the same page fills up progressively, making causal.
limit_zh: 只认白纸黑豆一种画风；输入必须是单段文字，不能是对话或多主题长文；产物是PNG序列，不含排版、配音或动效。
limit_en: Only white-paper black-bean style; single copy block only, no dialogues or multi-topic essays; outputs PNG sequence only—no layout, audio, or.
title_en: Three cumulative doodle frames, no repaint
